about: Word lessons a Khmer reader asks of a passage's chat (the card's Study the words, EC-428), in the languages the Bible is read in: Hebrew (HebrewTD, the Masoretic text with its vowels and accents), Greek (GREEKGNT, the 1904 text), Khmer (ពគប) and English (KJV). Each scenario is one conversation opened as a Bible view's robot opens it, then BUTTONS pressed in order (`press`: the newest answer's button whose words are that, else start with it, else hold it) -- a word is learned by its button. `expect` is the grader's key, never sent: the dictionary form, the kind and form of the word in this verse, and what it means, from the standard lexicons (BDB / HALOT for Hebrew, BDAG for Greek). `words` on a press that lists a verse's words is the list a right split gives. Graded per word: lemma, form, meaning, the verse's word kept as written, no romanisation of a Khmer word in a Khmer window. Run with scripts/lookup-run.mjs --scenarios=<this file>; first measured 2026-10-23 (EC-433).

asks.press: សិក្សាពាក្យនីមួយៗ
asks.expect: the verse's words as buttons, each once
the preposition בְּ 'in' + the noun רֵאשִׁית (feminine singular, 'beginning, first'), no article written; 'in the beginning'; said b'reshit
the verb בָּרָא (root ב-ר-א), Qal perfect 3rd person masculine singular, 'he created'; in the Bible only God is its subject; said bara
the noun אֱלֹהִים, plural in form, masculine, 'God' when it takes a singular verb as here (בָּרָא); said Elohim
the particle אֵת, marking the definite direct object; not translated; said et
the article הַ 'the' + the noun שָׁמַיִם (masculine, plural/dual in form), 'the heavens, the sky'; said hashamayim
the conjunction וְ 'and' + the object marker אֵת; said ve'et
the article הָ 'the' + the noun אֶרֶץ (feminine singular, 'earth, land'); said ha'arets

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the verse's words again

asks.press: ពាក្យទាំងអស់
asks.expect: one line a word for all 7, each in Hebrew as written, its dictionary form and meaning; ב+רֵאשִׁית, ברא Qal perfect 3ms, אֱלֹהִים, אֵת, הַ+שָׁמַיִם, וְ+אֵת, הָ+אֶרֶץ

asks.press: សិក្សាពាក្យនីមួយៗ
asks.expect: the words split at the maqaf (־) too, each once (אֱלֹהִים֮ / הַמַּ֨יִם֙ / לָרָקִ֔יעַ / אֲשֶׁר written twice with other accents are one word each)
the verb עָשָׂה 'make, do' with the consecutive וַ: Qal wayyiqtol (imperfect with waw-consecutive) 3rd person masculine singular, 'and he made'
the article הָ + the noun רָקִיעַ (masculine singular), 'the expanse, the firmament'

asks.press: សិក្សាពាក្យនីមួយៗ
asks.expect: the verse's words, ἀλλ’ kept with its elision mark
ἀγαπάω, aorist active indicative 3rd person singular, 'he loved'

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
the article ὁ, accusative singular masculine, 'the' (with κόσμον) -- not a preposition

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
μονογενής, adjective, accusative singular masculine (with υἱόν), 'only, one and only, unique' (KJV 'only begotten')

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
πιστεύω, present active participle, nominative singular masculine, 'believing' -- with ὁ, 'the one who believes'

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
ἀπόλλυμι, aorist middle subjunctive 3rd person singular (after ἵνα μή), 'perish, be lost'

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
αἰώνιος, adjective, accusative singular feminine (with ζωήν), 'eternal, everlasting'

asks.press: សិក្សាពាក្យនីមួយៗ
asks.expect: the verse's words, split at the Bible's zero-width spaces
a verb, 'love'; here God loved the people of the world; no pronunciation and no romanisation (the answer is in Khmer)

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again

asks.press: ព្រះ‌រាជ‌បុត្រា
asks.expect: a noun of the royal register: ព្រះ (sacred/royal) + រាជ (royal) + បុត្រា (son), 'the (royal) Son' -- here God's only Son; no romanisation

asks.press: សិក្សាពាក្យនីមួយៗ
asks.expect: the verse's words
the past participle of 'beget' (to father), an old English word; 'only begotten' = the one and only (Greek μονογενής); the English word kept

asks.press: ជ្រើសរើសពាក្យ
asks.expect: the words again
'believe' in its old 3rd person singular present (-eth = -s, 'believes'); 'whosoever believeth' = whoever believes
